description: Stop a model task that has not finished. A queued task is cancelled and never charged. A task that was already running can still be charged for its run, and get_task_price shows any charge once the run ends. If the task finished first, the call is refused with "Process ended": read it with get_task and show the result. Not for the steps of a workflow run or the runs Studio starts.

tasktoken.description: The task token returned from run_model.
